name: ox-cli-pr-header
description: Emit and paste the SageOx credit line at the TOP of a pull-request description — the human-facing counterpart to the machine `SageOx-Session:` trailer. Run `ox pr header` at PR-creation time; it renders a thin, on-brand, dark/light-aware single line linking the session(s), plan(s), and discussion(s) that produced the change and naming the team. The CLI owns the sanitizer-fragile markup — you never hand-author it. Use when opening a PR for AI coworker work, or when the user says "add the SageOx header", "credit the session on the PR", or "/ox-cli-pr-header".
